purpose: running shelter ledger against the $5M zero-basis LTCG realized in tax year 2026; drives the tax reserve and therefore the deployment budget
rate_note: CA blended LTCG = 20% fed + 3.8% NIIT + 13.3% CA

shelter_sources.basis: msprime gainloss_events view (deduped); 2,236 closing events; essentially all short-term
shelter_sources.note: the app's raw /gainloss/summary reported -$1.07M - a 2.5x double-count now fixed in the app (commit 53ad011)

verification_owed: is it a prior-year CARRYFORWARD (2025 Form 1040 Schedule D line 16 / capital loss carryover worksheet) or 2026 realized losses at another custodian?
both offset the gain, but a carryforward needs the prior return and current-year losses need a 1099-B
confirm CA conformity - CA generally follows the federal carryforward, but the CA basis can differ if there were prior-year adjustments
if the Wealthfront account held names Parametric or IBKR also traded, check 31-day wash-sale windows around its liquidation

marginal_value: every incremental $100k harvested before 2026-12-31 releases $37,100 from reserve into deployable capital

payment_calendar.safe_harbor: 110% of prior-year liability or 90% of current year

WHY_THE_RESERVE_IS_NOT_OPTIONAL: the gain is fixed in tax year 2026 and capital losses CANNOT carry backward. Deploying the reserve and losing it in 2027 leaves the full 2026 liability intact plus a 2027 carryforward with no gain to offset - the dot-com-option-exercise failure mode. Only losses realized BEFORE 2026-12-31 shelter this gain, and the board's modal break is 2027 - the wrong side of the line.
reserve_instrument: SGOV - 4.3% yield, state-tax-exempt (CA does not tax Treasury interest), zero duration, liquid on the exact payment dates
